review_scope: Product listing; product detail; cart; checkout
required_test: Check for fabricated countdown timers, false scarcity, expiring offers or urgency statements unsupported by live stock, supplier or offer records.

review_scope: Product detail; cart; checkout; payment review
required_test: Add an item and change quantity; inspect for preselected add-ons, insurance, donations, services, subscriptions or fees added without an affirmative choice.
Inspect decline/opt-out wording and visual hierarchy; declining optional add-ons, analytics or marketing must not be guilt-inducing or obstructed.
Check whether users must create an account, disclose unnecessary data, consent to optional processing or take unrelated actions to complete a purchase or exercise rights.
Review all recurring-payment, membership or repeat-order features. If none exist, record evidence and reviewer-confirmed not applicable.

review_scope: Product detail; cart; checkout; account; returns
required_test: Check whether important choices are hidden, visually downplayed, misdirected or made difficult to understand or reverse.

review_scope: Search; listing; product detail; cart; checkout
required_test: Compare advertised item, price, availability, fitment and delivery promise with what is actually selectable and supplied.

review_scope: Product detail; cart; checkout; payment review
required_test: Verify the full compulsory total, including shipping, taxes and fees, is shown before payment; compare displayed total with Cashfree order amount.
Review paid placements, affiliate links and promoted product positions. Mark sponsored content clearly at the placement; if no paid placement exists, document it.

review_scope: Home; listing; product detail; account; checkout
required_test: Check repeated prompts for app installs, login, notifications, reviews, newsletter or marketing that interrupt or pressure users after a clear choice.

review_scope: Terms; product detail; cart; checkout; cancellation; returns
required_test: Check labels, checkbox wording, button text and opt-out choices for ambiguity, double negatives or wording that misstates consequences.
Review auto-renewal, recurring billing, plan changes and cancellation only if such services exist; if absent, record evidence for not applicable.

review_scope: All pages; account; checkout; browser downloads
required_test: Check for deceptive downloads, malware-like installation prompts, forced extensions, unsafe redirects or unsolicited software.
